title: Published entrypoint points at an artifact this package does not build
reasoning: The package advertises dist/cli.js as its runtime entrypoint, but the configured scripts only run TypeScript directly with tsx or invoke quality/database commands. There is no build or prepack/prepublishOnly script in this config that would produce dist/cli.js before publishing or local consumption, so npm consumers can receive a package whose main entrypoint does not exist.
reproduction: From a clean checkout, run the package's release/pack workflow or install it as a dependency, then require/import the package entrypoint. Without an externally produced dist/cli.js, Node resolves package.json main to a missing file.
recommendation: Add an explicit build script that emits dist/cli.js and wire it into prepack/prepublishOnly, or change main to an entrypoint that actually exists in the distributed package. If this is intended to be CLI-only, also define a bin entry and ensure the built CLI is included in the package.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: No tests are linked for this feature, and the package test script targets src/**/*.test.ts rather than validating packed artifacts or package entrypoint resolution.
suggestedRegressionTest: Add a release smoke test that runs the build, packs the package, installs/extracts the tarball in a temporary directory, and verifies the package main entrypoint resolves successfully.
minimumFixScope: package.json scripts and package entrypoint metadata
